dock.empty: Your wrongbook is empty. Go practice some questions.
setting.dailyGoal.title: Daily practice size
setting.dailyGoal.desc: Number of questions pushed by the daily hook (due reviews first, then high-frequency points).
setting.retention.title: Desired retention
setting.retention.desc: The only FSRS parameter you need to care about: higher = stronger memory but more reviews. Default 0.9, recommended 0.85-0.97.
setting.aiEndpoint.title: AI endpoint
setting.aiEndpoint.desc: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://.../v1/chat/completions). Only selected questions or notes are sent when you explicitly call AI; your bank remains local by default.
setting.aiKey.title: AI API key
setting.aiKey.desc: Stored only in local plugin data, used for AI question generation and explanation.
